title: Directional Connectivity-based Segmentation of Medical Images
mechanism: Predict 8-neighbour pixel connectivity maps per class, with a decoder that disentangles and tracks directional sub-spaces; the mask is recovered from connectivity votes.
adaptation: Connectivity output only for crack and inactive (2 x 8 channels) on the ResNet-34 encoder, keep the 24-class CE head. Hoped effect: fewer fragmented crack pieces, more components found, cleaner inactive borders.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + DconnNet connectivity heads for crack/inactive; baseline = PF; 5 seeds + 5-fold CV; metrics components >=20 px found, relF1@2, inactive IoU. Kill if components gain < 0.02 and inactive IoU flat.
evidence: R: beats SOTA on several public medical segmentation benchmarks; third-party listings show DRIVE and CRACK500 results (not read).

alt_notes.adaptation: Add an 8-channel connectivity head for crack and gridline to U-Net++ (BCE), fused at inference. Build connectivity targets from labels dilated by 1 px, because 1-2 px jittered traces give noisy direction targets.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + connectivity head (crack, gridline), 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: gridline IoU, crack component recall, crack IoU. Kill if gridline gain < 0.02 and component recall gain < 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Connectivity output for crack and inactive only (2 x 8 channels) on the ResNet-34 U-Net++ encoder, 24-class CE head kept. Binary connectivity flips under 1 px jitter, so pair with a 1 px tube target or use TMAL instead.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm PF + DconnNet crack/inactive heads vs PF; metric components >=20 px found and inactive IoU; kill if components +<0.02 and inactive IoU flat (within 0.01).

alt_notes.adaptation: Use a multi-class connectivity head on crack, inactive and gridline on top of the U-Net++ decoder. Inactive touches crack in 99% of regions, so crack-inactive connectivity is a natural constraint.
alt_notes.min_experiment: DconnNet head vs house, 5 seeds. Metrics: inactive IoU on 5-fold CV (test inactive rests on 3 cells) and crack relF1@2. Kill if inactive CV IoU gains < 0.02 and crack is flat.

alt_notes.adaptation: Extra connectivity head only for crack, inactive and gridline (24x8 channels is wasteful); connectivity targets built from labels dilated by 1 px to absorb jitter; keep the CE+Dice mask head.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + 3-class connectivity head, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metrics: components >=20 px found, crack relF1@2, inactive IoU. Kill: components found and relF1@2 gains both < 0.01.
